title: Kit Lifecycle Workflow
description: Follow one kit from a gap on the shelf through purchase, prep, circulation, and the three-way decision that decides its fate.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Managing Your Kit Inventory and Signal Processing Kits

educational.audience: Club leaders and mentors managing a kit shelf

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a kit's current lifecycle stage and its damage-assessment outcome, the learner differentiates whether the kit should be reused as-is, sent down an upgrade path, or retired.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Hover-to-preview and click-to-pin lifecycle map with two decision points and three loops back into circulation
pedagogical.assessment: Give a returned kit with a bent but reseatable pin and ask which branch it takes and where it rejoins the loop.
